summary.text: Ben Bumgarner is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 63 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A firearms manufacturer, he previously served on the Flower Mound Town Council.

paragraphs.text: Ben Bumgarner was born in Texas and lives in Flower Mound, and he graduated from McKinney High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Austin College in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a firearms manufacturer and owning Evolve Weapons Systems.
He served on the Flower Mound Town Council, including as mayor pro tem.
Bumgarner took office on January 10, 2023, succeeding Tan Parker.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Defense & Veterans' Affairs and International Relations & Economic Development.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed property tax reform, protecting Second Amendment rights and limiting government as his key messages.
